subject.title: Feature: Slack workspace file injection + global systemPrompt (parity with Telegram)

question: Should OpenClaw add a Slack account/global `systemPrompt` surface now, and what precedence should it have across wildcard/per-channel prompts, DMs, MPIMs, normal messages, and slash commands?
rationale: Current main proves the requested global prompt surface is absent, but prior maintainer review rejected an ad hoc local prompt-stacking shape, so automation should not choose the public config API or precedence policy.

options.title: Add canonical Slack global prompt
options.body: Define a single Slack account/global `systemPrompt` contract, stack it below shared Project Context and before narrower overrides, and require schema/docs/tests for room, DM, MPIM, and slash paths.

options.title: Keep only scoped prompts
options.body: Close the global prompt portion as not planned and document per-channel or wildcard channel prompts as the supported Slack customization path.

options.title: Use include-text only for ergonomics
options.body: Let PR #87771 solve file-backed prompt maintenance for existing string fields without adding a new Slack global prompt surface.

recommendation.title: Add canonical Slack global prompt
recommendation.body: Define a single Slack account/global `systemPrompt` contract, stack it below shared Project Context and before narrower overrides, and require schema/docs/tests for room, DM, MPIM, and slash paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They owned the prior Slack prompt product boundary decisions in PR #59100 and PR #46036.
